set.body: Build on graphics/README.md and the standalone vector recording foundation. Specify reusable resolved text layout/font identity and epoch, immutable or versioned image inputs, recording resource availability and backend/device preparation invalidation under VISION sections 5–7. Extend the public-only general authoring corpus and operation-level reference inventory without dummy font/image handles or parallel text layout. Define the bounded wgpu/ThorVG probe protocol and resource/ownership mappings before renderer expansion. No graphics or Native interoperability claim without evidence.
set.title: G-0/G-1: Define shared text, image and preparation resource contracts
